summary: Regolo's startup partnership: 60 days of free unlimited tokens (up to 50M tokens/day) across 100+ open-source models on EU-hosted, zero-data-retention, OpenAI-compatible infrastructure. No credit card for the free period; applications reviewed within ~48 hours. In return, accepted startups do light co-marketing (logo, content, mentions). Active teams can later apply for a voucher up to €2,000 valid up to 12 months. Linked general service terms require prior written authorization for reselling, redistributing or offering Regolo as part of a commercial service, including commercial API routing. Confirm the permissions and any separate agreement for your product during program acceptance. Those terms also contain restrictive/inconsistent high-risk-use wording; do not infer authorization for a regulated deployment from the marketing page alone.
claim_steps: Apply via the Builder Program form at https://regolo.ai/builder-program/ (applications reviewed within 48 hours, cohorts limited).
No credit card needed for the 60-day free period.
Accepted startups add the Regolo logo to their site and publish real usage content.

Before shipping a commercial API-backed service, confirm written authorization and any separate agreement under the linked general terms. Confirm high-risk/regulated use with Regolo; marketing does not itself settle those permissions.
